title: outcome_evidence (ADDITIVE — investigation prototype, jun13_eval)
description: An ADDITIVE, source-grounded evidence block proposed to sit ALONGSIDE the existing `outcome` field on a call_record. It NEVER replaces `outcome.task_completed`. Where the public source dataset (SpokenWOZ raw log / Code-Mixed-Dialog backend trace) provides ground truth, this block records inspectable per-signal evidence and a conservative roll-up verdict in {success, fail, unknown}. `unknown` is a first-class value: it is emitted whenever the source trace does not contain enough evidence to decide, and the probe NEVER guesses.

groundable.description: false for non_public families (frozen bolna/hero) — no source ground truth exists, verdict is forced to `unknown`.

source_ref.description: raw dialogue id / index used as the ground-truth pointer (e.g. SpokenWOZ MUL0035, or dialog#12).

signals.description: Per-signal evidence. Each signal is the source-truth value, or the string "unknown" when not computable / not applicable. A non-applicable conditional signal (e.g. booking on a no-booking call) is "unknown", never a fabricated pass.

constraint_supplied.description: swz: user declared >=1 info constraint in the goal.

constraint_preserved_frac.description: swz: fraction of goal.info constraints present in the FINAL belief-state (semi/book).

reqt_supplied_frac.description: swz: fraction of goal.reqt slots the system informed via *-inform/*-recommend dialog acts.

booking_required.description: swz: goal contains a book block.

booking_confirmed.description: swz: booking-book act w/ payload, OR non-empty booked list, OR *-ack carrying committed book* slots; "unknown" when no booking required.

constraints_in_api_call_frac.description: cmd: fraction of user-named facet VALUES (area/price/cuisine) that appear in some api_call query.

selected_entity.description: cmd: the KB entity the agent actually voiced (delex token in a system turn); null if none.

kb_candidate_count.description: cmd: number of distinct KB entities returned across all api_calls.

entity_voiced.description: cmd: a returned KB entity was voiced in a system turn.

info_requests_frac.description: cmd: fraction of user info requests (phone/address/postcode/price) the system voiced.

no_result_count.description: cmd: count of `api_call no result` backend misses.

no_result_recovered.description: cmd: an entity surfaced after a miss; "unknown" when no miss occurred.

agent_contradicts_backend.description: cmd: a facet (area/price/cuisine) the agent voiced about the SELECTED entity conflicts with that entity's KB row. A true here is a hard fail.

rollup_rules.note: Conservative. A single hard grounding failure forces `fail`; success requires positive evidence on every applicable signal; otherwise `unknown`.
